author: hdprajwal
abstract: Executes a written implementation plan inline in the current session with review checkpoints: load the plan, review it critically, run each task exactly with its verifications, stop and ask when blocked rather than guessing. The single-session alternative to subagent-driven-development. Adapted from obra/superpowers' executing-plans skill. Tuned to hdprajwal's actual workflow (branch → PR → merge loop, specs in docs/, pnpm + cargo, runtime-proof verification, short plain prose) based on usage analysis.
